strings: r_c asks m_c if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could use some help getting introduced to the other Clan members.
r_c offers herbs lessons to m_c in case {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/aren/isn}'t familiar with the more dangerous plants in the territory.
r_c introduces {PRONOUN/r_c/self} as c_n's medicine cat and asks m_c to let {PRONOUN/r_c/object} know if m_c ever feels ill.
